name: Workday - Login Activity
description: The Workday - Login Activity dashboard provides detailed insights into login summary, trends and malicious activities. Panel also displays the recent login activity and the information of various devices and browsers used.
title: Workday - Login Activity

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday* 
| json "System_Account", "Session_IP_Address", "Request_Originator","Failed_Signon","tenant_name" nodrop
| where !(System_Account matches "wd-*") and Session_IP_Address matches "{{SessionIPAddress}}" and System_Account matches "{{SystemUser}}" and tenant_name matches "{{TenantName}}" and Request_Originator matches "{{RequestOriginator}}" and Failed_Signon = 1 
| count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday* 
| json "System_Account", "Session_IP_Address", "Request_Originator", "Device_Type","tenant_name" nodrop
| where !(System_Account matches "wd-*") and Session_IP_Address matches "{{SessionIPAddress}}" and System_Account matches "{{SystemUser}}" and tenant_name matches "{{TenantName}}" and Request_Originator matches "{{RequestOriginator}}"
| if(isBlank(device_type),"Unknown", device_type) as device_type
| count by device_type
| sort by _count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday* 
| json "System_Account", "Session_IP_Address", "Request_Originator", "tenant_name" nodrop
| where !(System_Account matches "wd-*") and Session_IP_Address matches "{{SessionIPAddress}}" and System_Account matches "{{SystemUser}}" and tenant_name matches "{{TenantName}}" and Request_Originator matches "{{RequestOriginator}}"
| if(isBlank(Request_Originator),"Unknown", Request_Originator) as Request_Originator
| count by Request_Originator
| sort by _count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday* 
| json "System_Account", "Session_IP_Address", "Request_Originator", "tenant_name" nodrop
| where !(System_Account matches "wd-*") and Session_IP_Address matches "{{SessionIPAddress}}" and System_Account matches "{{SystemUser}}" and tenant_name matches "{{TenantName}}" and Request_Originator matches "{{RequestOriginator}}"
| count as %"Count" by System_Account
| sort by %"Count"

_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday* 
| json "Session_Start", "Device_is_Trusted", "Invalid_Credentials", "Account_Locked__Disabled_or_Expired", "Authentication_Type_for_Signon", "Session_ID", "System_Account", "Session_IP_Address", "Request_Originator", "Failed_Signon","tenant_name" nodrop
| where !(System_Account matches "wd-*") and Failed_Signon=1 and Session_IP_Address matches "{{SessionIPAddress}}" and System_Account matches "{{SystemUser}}" and tenant_name matches "{{TenantName}}" and Request_Originator matches "{{RequestOriginator}}"
| count by Session_Start,System_Account,Session_IP_Address,Request_Originator,Device_is_Trusted,Invalid_Credentials,Account_Locked__Disabled_or_Expired,Authentication_Type_for_Signon,Session_ID
| fields -_count
| sort by Session_Start
| limit 20

_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday*  !"Workday Internal"
| json "System_Account", "Session_IP_Address", "Request_Originator", "tenant_name" nodrop
| where !(System_Account matches "wd-*") and Session_IP_Address matches "{{SessionIPAddress}}" and System_Account matches "{{SystemUser}}" and tenant_name matches "{{TenantName}}" and Request_Originator matches "{{RequestOriginator}}"
| count as %"Count" by Session_IP_Address
| top 10 Session_IP_Address by %"Count"

_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday* 
| json "System_Account", "Session_IP_Address", "Request_Originator", "Device_Type","tenant_name" as %"System User", session_ip_address, Request_Originator, %"Device Type", tenant_name nodrop
| where !(%"System User" matches "wd-*") and session_ip_address matches "{{SessionIPAddress}}" and %"System User" matches "{{SystemUser}}" and Request_Originator matches "{{RequestOriginator}}" and tenant_name matches "{{TenantName}}" and session_ip_address != "0.0.0.0" and session_ip_address != "127.0.0.1" and session_ip_address!="Workday Internal"
| count by %"System User", %"Device Type", session_ip_address
|  lookup type, actor, raw, threatlevel as malicious_confidence from sumo://threat/cs on threat=session_ip_address
| where  type="ip_address" and !isNull(malicious_confidence)
| json field=raw "malware_families[*]" as threat_malware_families nodrop
| json field=raw "last_updated" as last_updated nodrop
| formatDate(fromseconds(last_updated), "MM-dd-yyyy") as %"Threat Last Updated" 
| json field=raw "labels[*].name" as label_name nodrop
| replace(label_name, "\\/","->") as label_name
| replace(label_name, "\""," ") as label_name
| where !(label_name matches "*TorProxy*")
| if (isEmpty(actor), "Unassigned", actor) as actor
| malicious_confidence as %"Malicious Confidence"
| session_ip_address as %"Malicious IP"
| Actor as %"Malicious Actor"
| count as %"Count" by %"System User", %"Malicious IP", %"Device Type", %"Malicious Actor", %"Malicious Confidence", %"Threat Last Updated"

panels.title: Last 20 Recent Logins from Untrusted Devices

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday* 
| json "Session_Start", "Device_is_Trusted", "Invalid_Credentials", "Account_Locked__Disabled_or_Expired", "Authentication_Type_for_Signon", "Session_ID", "System_Account", "Session_IP_Address", "Request_Originator", "Failed_Signon","tenant_name" nodrop
| where Device_is_Trusted=0 and !(System_Account matches "wd-*") and Session_IP_Address matches "{{SessionIPAddress}}" and System_Account matches "{{SystemUser}}" and tenant_name matches "{{TenantName}}" and Request_Originator matches "{{RequestOriginator}}"
| count by Session_Start,System_Account,Session_IP_Address,Request_Originator,Device_is_Trusted,Invalid_Credentials,Account_Locked__Disabled_or_Expired,Authentication_Type_for_Signon,Session_ID
| fields -_count
| sort by Session_Start
| limit 20

_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday* 
| json "System_Account", "Session_IP_Address", "Request_Originator", "Authentication_Type_for_Signon", "tenant_name" nodrop
| where !(System_Account matches "wd-*") and Session_IP_Address matches "{{SessionIPAddress}}" and System_Account matches "{{SystemUser}}" and tenant_name matches "{{TenantName}}" and Request_Originator matches "{{RequestOriginator}}"
| count by Authentication_Type_for_Signon
| sort by _count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday* 
| json "requestTime", "ipAddress", "systemAccount", "taskDisplayName", "target.descriptor", "sessionId", "activityAction", "deviceType", "userAgent", "tenant_name" as Time, ipAddress, %"System User", Task, Target, SessionID, ActivityAction, DeviceType, %"User Agent",tenant_name nodrop
| where %"System User" matches "{{SystemUser}}" and tenant_name matches "{{TenantName}}" and ipAddress matches "{{SessionIPAddress}}"
| if(isBlank(%"User Agent"), "Unknown", %"User Agent") as %"User Agent" 
| count as %"Count" by %"User Agent"
| -1*%"Count" as %"Count"
| top 10 %"User Agent" by %"Count"
| -1*%"Count" as %"Count"

_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday* 
| json "requestTime", "ipAddress", "systemAccount", "taskDisplayName", "target.descriptor", "sessionId", "activityAction", "deviceType", "userAgent", "tenant_name" as Time, ipAddress, %"System User", Task, Target, SessionID, ActivityAction, DeviceType, %"User Agent", tenant_name nodrop
| where %"System User" matches "{{SystemUser}}" and tenant_name matches "{{TenantName}}" and ipAddress matches "{{SessionIPAddress}}"
| if(isBlank(%"User Agent"), "Unknown", %"User Agent") as %"User Agent" 
| count as %"Count" by %"User Agent"
| top 10 %"User Agent" by %"Count"

_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday* 
| json "System_Account", "Session_IP_Address", "Request_Originator","Authentication_Failure_Message", "tenant_name" nodrop
| where !(System_Account matches "wd-*") and Session_IP_Address matches "{{SessionIPAddress}}" and System_Account matches "{{SystemUser}}" and tenant_name matches "{{TenantName}}" and Request_Originator matches "{{RequestOriginator}}" and !isBlank(Authentication_Failure_Message)
| count by Authentication_Failure_Message
| if (isBlank(Authentication_Failure_Message), "Unknown", Authentication_Failure_Message) as Authentication_Failure_Message
| sort by _count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday* 
| json "System_Account", "Session_IP_Address", "Request_Originator","Failed_Signon","tenant_name" nodrop
| where Failed_Signon = 0 and !(System_Account matches "wd-*") and Session_IP_Address matches "{{SessionIPAddress}}" and System_Account matches "{{SystemUser}}" and tenant_name matches "{{TenantName}}" and Request_Originator matches "{{RequestOriginator}}"
| count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Workday* 
| json "System_Account", "Session_IP_Address", "Request_Originator","Failed_Signon","tenant_name" nodrop
| where !(System_Account matches "wd-*") and Session_IP_Address matches "{{SessionIPAddress}}" and System_Account matches "{{SystemUser}}" and tenant_name matches "{{TenantName}}" and Request_Originator matches "{{RequestOriginator}}"
| timeslice 1h
| if (Failed_Signon == "1", 1, 0) as is_failed_signon
| if (Failed_Signon == "1", 0, 1) as is_successful_signon
| sum(is_failed_signon) as failed_signon_count, sum(is_successful_signon) as successful_signon_count, count(Failed_Signon) as total_sigons by _timeslice
| (failed_signon_count*100/total_sigons) as failed_sigon_percent
| (successful_signon_count*100/total_sigons) as successful_sigon_percent
| fields -successful_signon_count,failed_signon_count,total_sigons
